resultRules.pass: Every required expectation was independently heard or reached without assistance.
resultRules.fail: The tester completed the step but one or more expectations were not met.
resultRules.blocker: The step could not be completed or interpreted, including any sighted assistance, infrastructure failure, missing test data, crash, or AT/browser failure.

setup: Start Chrome with no other extensions changing page content.
Start NVDA and record its exact version from NVDA > Help > About.
Use NVDA+Space to select Browse mode; use NVDA+F7 to confirm the Elements List opens.
Open the bound localBaseUrl and use Ctrl+L, type the exact route URL, then press Enter for direct navigation.

keys.activate: Enter or Space as announced for the control

setup: In Safari Settings > Advanced, enable Press Tab to highlight each item on a webpage.
Start VoiceOver with Command+F5 and record the exact macOS, Safari, and VoiceOver versions.
Use Control+Option+U to confirm the rotor opens; Escape closes it.
Open the bound localBaseUrl and use Command+L, type the exact route URL, then press Return for direct navigation.

keys.top: Control+Option+Home (or Control+Option+Fn+Left Arrow on keyboards where Home requires Fn)
keys.rotor: Control+Option+U; Left/Right to Headings, Landmarks, or Links; Up/Down to an item; Return to move

journeys.name: Every shipped route: page, skip link, headings, landmarks, actions

steps.operation: For each routes[] entry, navigate directly, move to the top, then press the platform nextFocus key once.
expectations: Product and page context are announced, not a logo or filename.
Skip to main content / Saltar al contenido principal is the first focus target and has role link.
Activation moves focus to the unique main landmark.

steps.operation: Use the platform heading command through the page, then its landmark command/rotor.
expectations: Exactly one h1 is announced and heading levels do not skip.
Exactly one banner, navigation, main, and contentinfo landmark is announced; a missing or duplicate required landmark is a fail.

steps.operation: Tab through every visible action without using a mouse.
expectations: Every action in the route actionIds is reached in DOM order with its visible label as its accessible name.
Role and pressed/checked/expanded/disabled/busy state are announced when applicable.
Nothing is announced only as graphic and focus is never lost or trapped.

journeys.name: Home to service search and listing meaning

expectations: Find a service tile heading is heard before Browse services; the ES candidate also exposes its translation-review notice.
Page change announces Services directory and focus can reach main; the ES candidate also exposes its translation-review notice.
Search results announce once after activation, not per keystroke.
Listing chips/statuses are spoken as words and meanings, never color alone.

journeys.name: Ride required error, step position, read-back, and submission status

expectations: Required error is announced, focus moves to the field, and the corrective message is reachable through its description.
Each product step announces its position and question; if the integrated single-page form has no such steps, record fail.
Read-back is continuous with no interactive controls interleaved.
Saving and final non-confirmation status are announced once each.
Pressed state and confirmation are announced.
Easy bar exposes two links named Help me / Ayúdeme and Call a person / Llamar a una persona.
html language and VoiceOver/NVDA pronunciation change to Spanish.
English held for review remains explicitly English and is associated with its review affordance.
Pressed state and confirmation are announced; Easy-only bar is absent.
html language and pronunciation return to English.

steps.operation: Execute each actionId in order using only the keyboard and the assigned synthetic fixtures.
expectations: The named role, accessible name, control state, and live announcement match the action expectation.
Each result is heard once and remains discoverable after speech finishes.
No result relies on sight, color, screenshot interpretation, or another person's help.

evidenceRequirements.media: Screenshots may show focus/state; recordings may preserve speech and timing. Media never replaces the verbatim transcript or keyboard record.
evidenceRequirements.privacy: Use only designated synthetic records. Do not capture credentials, real names, phone numbers, email addresses, or health/assistance narratives.
